Straight answers, no fluff.Who is Tulala for?Anyone who sells their work or runs a business around people: singers, chefs, stylists, cleaners, photographers, coaches; salons, studios and agencies; and city hubs that connect local pros with clients. If you've ever booked work over WhatsApp, this is for you.Is there really a free plan?Yes, a genuinely useful free plan, not a trial in disguise. You get a free page, a shareable link, reservations, and a real inquiry inbox. No credit card required.Can I use my own domain?Yes, on the paid plans. Bring your own domain and get full control over your pages, design, and brand. Your site looks like a real business, because it is one.How is this different from Squarespace or Notion?Those are just for presentation. You'd still juggle bookings in WhatsApp, payments somewhere else, and your schedule in your head. Tulala is the whole thing: a site, a booking flow, payments, and a shared discovery network, built around how service businesses actually work.Do I have to be on the shared network?No. The network is opt-in, per business and per profile. Run Tulala as a private branded site, appear in the network, or both. You control what's discoverable.What happens to my data if I leave?It stays yours. Full export of your profiles, media, and booking history is available on every paid plan. No lock-in, no hostage data.Can my team work in it together?Yes, paid plans support multiple users with roles and permissions: owners, admins, coordinators, assistants. Everyone works in the same place with the right level of access.Does it work outside the US?Yes. Spanish and English, multi-currency pricing, and a design that travels cleanly across markets.
